mini_task_spec:
You are working in a NestJS monorepo at `test-repo/`. Your task is to identify which files in `test-repo/packages/core/injector/` are the most "hot" (most frequently referenced) by counting how many distinct `.ts` files within `test-repo/packages/core/` import each of these five injector files: `container.ts`, `instance-wrapper.ts`, `module.ts`, `injector.ts`, and `constants.ts`.

For each of these five files, count the number of unique `.ts` files within `test-repo/packages/core/` that contain at least one import path matching `injector/<basename>` (e.g., `injector/container`, `injector/instance-wrapper`, etc.). Report the five files ranked by their import count in descending order, with ties broken alphabetically by filename. Use the format:

```
<basename>.ts: <count>
```

(one per line, ranked highest to lowest)
